primaryRepositories.method: Hosted web sender loads official Google SDK; CastContext setOptions, google-cast-launcher, MediaInfo/LoadRequest and loadMedia; local HTML5 and remote controls share UI. Example currently selects its published demo receiver, with comments explaining Default Media Receiver. Uses network media URLs, not private File bytes.

findings.finding: The current clientId, sequenceNumber, message.sessionId and v2_message layout agrees with Chromium156. LOAD/GET_STATUS are forwarded as media commands. client_connect is obsolete and explicitly ignored. Missing explicit CASTV2 CONNECT/requestId at the JS layer is not an established bug because Chromium handles those layers.

Blink creates and initializes the connection then resolves start(); incoming Mojo events run on presentation tasks. The await continuation attaches listeners before subsequent queued events under normal task ordering. No definite dropped-new_session race was established. Physical receiver exchange remains unobserved.

Alcydeo never sends hlsSegmentFormat/hlsVideoSegmentFormat. Protocol documentation describes default TS expectations and explicit FMP4 fields for CMAF; MediaInformation reference qualifies the requirement for MPL. A checked fMP4 HLS source should preserve its real packaging in LOAD. This is a concrete format-description gap, not proof of the reported universal failure or a local-file transport fix.

Alcydeo permits URLs up to16384 characters and puts the full URL in contentId; message docs specify contentId up to1k. contentUrl exists for actual transport URL separate from identifier. A short stable ID plus exact contentUrl would require updating response matching, which currently only accepts contentId equal to the URL. No receiver rejection for a long actual user URL has been observed.

Unchanged snapshot62 quickMessage and native PresentationRequest.start were exercised with only checkSource readiness delay injected. Both incoming extension messages had activation=true. At100ms native start retained activation and rejected NotFoundError without a receiver. At6500ms native start had activation=false and rejected InvalidAccessError; sender nevertheless got started:true. Manual click after readiness retained activation and reached NotFoundError. This proves the delayed path bug, not the actual user device cause.

Officially documented web integration uses an HTTPS sender and the remote Google SDK; Default Media Receiver needs no custom receiver registration. It still requires a receiver-reachable media URL and codecs. It does not turn a private PC file into a remote HTTP source or guarantee sources needing browser cookies/headers.

Chrome policy exempts isolated iframe/sandbox contexts from the remote-code restriction under review/data requirements. Therefore a blanket assertion that SDK execution is impossible in every extension context would be inaccurate. The current project contract is stricter: no remote executable code in the extension. Opaque origin, presentation permission and activation of a sandbox SDK have not been prototyped; no silent architecture change is recommended.
